<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Lack of Real-Time Reserve Visibility",
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot see how financial reserves align with supplier updates in real time. This lack of oversight prevents them from effectively monitoring supplier performance and managing financial controls."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 2,
 "mentions_n": 2,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "sales": 2
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 1680000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 1,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Marrowgate Commercial",
   "arr_gbp": 1600000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2026-12-12",
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Duncastle Auto",
   "arr_gbp": 80000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-08-19",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "f198f05f3726bee3",
  "quote": "especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time",
  "account": "Marrowgate Commercial",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-17T13:44:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "f8c9ec288b00cc31",
  "quote": "we need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance.",
  "account": "Duncastle Auto",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-14T16:28:00Z"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Users cannot see how financial reserves align with supplier updates in real time, which prevents them from monitoring supplier performance and managing financial controls. This gap shows up in the sales route, where 2 mentions across 2 accounts describe the same need for real-time visibility into reserves and supplier activity [i:f198f05f3726bee3][i:f8c9ec288b00cc31].

## Who is affected

- Marrowgate Commercial, an account with 1600000.0 GBP in ARR and a renewal on 2026-12-12, wants to see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time [i:f198f05f3726bee3].
- Duncastle Auto, an account with 80000.0 GBP in ARR and a renewal on 2027-08-19, needs better oversight on reserves and supplier performance [i:f8c9ec288b00cc31].

## Evidence

- Across 2 accounts and 2 mentions, all 2 mentions arrived through the sales route, and the total ARR represented is 1680000.0 GBP [i:f198f05f3726bee3][i:f8c9ec288b00cc31].
- Marrowgate Commercial raised the need for real-time syncing of reserves and payments with supplier updates, saying "especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time" [i:f198f05f3726bee3].
- Duncastle Auto framed the same gap as an oversight problem, saying "we need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance." [i:f8c9ec288b00cc31].
- 1 of the 2 accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal within the next 90 days, on 2026-12-12 [i:f198f05f3726bee3].

## Why now

- 1 renewal falls within 90 days, at Marrowgate Commercial on 2026-12-12, and that account carries 1600000.0 GBP of the 1680000.0 GBP total ARR in scope [i:f198f05f3726bee3].
- The evidence base is small: 2 accounts, 2 mentions and 1 route, all sales, as of 2026-11-03, so the pattern is directional rather than broad [i:f198f05f3726bee3][i:f8c9ec288b00cc31].
- No cited insight argues against the need for real-time reserve visibility; both cited accounts describe the same gap [i:f198f05f3726bee3][i:f8c9ec288b00cc31].
", "citations": ["f198f05f3726bee3", "f8c9ec288b00cc31"]}
